vuln_statements.explanation: This allocation statement at line 239/444 is vulnerable because it allocates connection tracking objects without proper synchronization checks. If the connection list is accessed concurrently during garbage collection (as mentioned in relevance=0.75), use-after-free vulnerabilities could occur when conn->tuple is assigned at line 245. The allocation happens in a critical path where race conditions between connection tracking cleanup and new allocations can lead to memory corruption.

This overflow check at lines 234-237 (mentioned in relevance=0.85) validates list->count against INT_MAX before allocating new nodes. Improper handling of this check could lead to integer overflow vulnerabilities in connection tracking, allowing malicious actors to bypass limits and cause denial of service through excessive connection counts.
